title.en: Who fights inflation? The RBI, the MPC and the four per cent target
title.hi: महँगाई से कौन लड़ता है? रिज़र्व बैंक, मौद्रिक नीति समिति और चार प्रतिशत का लक्ष्य

sources.name: RBI, Monetary Policy Statement 2026-27: Resolution of the Monetary Policy Committee, October 5 to 7, 2026
sources.what: Repo rate raised 25 bps to 5.50% unanimously; SDF 5.25%, MSF 5.75%; stance calibrated tightening; drivers (deficient monsoon, El Nino, onion and sugar spikes, inflation expectations); Aug 2026 CPI 4.8%, core 4.2%; Q3 projection 6.0%; MPC members, Governor as chair; next meeting Dec 2 to 4, 2026

sources.name: RBI, Minutes of the MPC meeting, October 5 to 7, 2026 (published October 21, 2026)
sources.what: Vote 6-0 for the hike; MPC publishes minutes

sources.name: MoSPI/NSO, Press Release on CPI (Base 2024=100) for October 2026, 12 November 2026
sources.what: October 2026 headline CPI 6.09%, food 8.94%; onion +116.22%, garlic, ginger, lemon up; potato and cauliflower down; base 2024; compiled by NSO, MoSPI

sources.name: RBI Bulletin, speech by Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta, 'Inflation Targeting in India: The Past, The Present and The Future' (May 2026)
sources.what: Target of 4% with plus or minus 2% band renewed through March 2031; headline CPI retained; 75 direct responses to consultation; RBI Act amended May 2016; average inflation 8.1% pre-IT decade vs 4.6% in IT period

sources.name: RBI, Review of Monetary Policy Framework: A Discussion Paper, August 21, 2025
sources.what: Central Government determines CPI inflation target once every five years (Section 45ZA); four review questions; headline vs core debate; 2022 breach, MPC meeting of November 3, 2022 and report sent to the Central Government

sources.name: Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 (rbi.org.in)
sources.what: Preamble: primary objective price stability while keeping in mind growth; Section 2 defines inflation as year-wise change in monthly CPI; section headings 45ZA, 45ZB, 45ZN

sources.name: RBI press release, Additional meeting of the Monetary Policy Committee for 2022-23, October 27, 2022
sources.what: Additional MPC meeting on November 3, 2022 under Section 45ZN

sources.name: NCAER Working Paper 174, Eichengreen and Gupta (2024), hosted by NITI Aayog
sources.what: Failure = outside 2 to 6% for three consecutive quarters; report gives reasons, remedial actions, time period; MPC of six with three government-appointed external members for four years; at least four meetings a year; WPI is wholesale and excludes services; breach Jan to Sep 2022

q.en: Under the RBI Act, who decides the inflation target?
q.hi: रिज़र्व बैंक अधिनियम के तहत मुद्रास्फीति का लक्ष्य कौन तय करता है?

en: The Central Government in consultation with the RBI
hi: रिज़र्व बैंक से परामर्श करके केंद्र सरकार

why.en: Section 45ZA gives the Central Government the power, in consultation with the RBI, once every five years; the MPC only sets the repo rate.
why.hi: धारा 45ZA के तहत केंद्र सरकार रिज़र्व बैंक से परामर्श करके हर पाँच साल में लक्ष्य तय करती है; समिति केवल रेपो दर तय करती है।

q.en: Which index does the inflation target use?
q.hi: मुद्रास्फीति का लक्ष्य किस सूचकांक पर आधारित है?

why.en: The RBI Act defines inflation as the yearly change in monthly CPI; the WPI has no services and is not the target.
why.hi: अधिनियम मुद्रास्फीति को मासिक सीपीआई में सालाना बदलाव मानता है; डब्ल्यूपीआई में सेवाएँ नहीं होतीं।

q.en: When is the RBI deemed to have failed its inflation target?
q.hi: रिज़र्व बैंक को लक्ष्य में नाकाम कब माना जाता है?

en: Inflation above six per cent in any single month
Yearly average above four per cent
Average inflation outside the two to six per cent band for three consecutive quarters
hi: किसी एक महीने में मुद्रास्फीति छह प्रतिशत से ऊपर
सालाना औसत चार प्रतिशत से ऊपर
औसत मुद्रास्फीति लगातार तीन तिमाहियों तक दो से छह प्रतिशत के बैंड से बाहर

why.en: Failure needs three consecutive quarters outside the band; one month above six, like October 2026, is not a failure.
why.hi: नाकामी के लिए लगातार तीन तिमाहियाँ बैंड से बाहर होनी चाहिए; अक्टूबर 2026 जैसा एक महीना नाकामी नहीं है।

factsToCheck: Exact date and Gazette number of the 2026 notification retaining the 4% (2 to 6%) target for 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2031: press reports say 25 March 2026; official Gazette/PIB text not opened, so the script gives no date (RBI speech confirms the renewal).

Full text of Sections 45ZA, 45ZB, 45ZI and 45ZN: the India Code and rbidocs PDFs did not load fully; the report contents (reasons, remedial actions, time estimate) and MPC structure are taken from RBI's discussion paper and the NCAER paper hosted by NITI Aayog.
Governor's casting vote in a tie and MPC quorum: left out, statutory text not opened.
WPI publisher (Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT) and new WPI base 2022-23: left out, not opened today.
CPI base year 2024 'since February 2026': base 2024 confirmed in the October 2026 MoSPI release; the February 2026 start date is from the app's note, not opened today.

The 2022 breach: script says inflation stayed above 6% for three quarters in a row from January to September 2022 (NCAER paper); RBI's discussion paper says it stayed above 6% for five consecutive quarters, Q4 2021-22 to Q4 2022-23. Both consistent; the trigger was the first three.
The repo rate is 5.50% as of 21 November 2026; the MPC meets 2 to 4 December 2026 and the figure may change after that.
notes: The headline-versus-core debate in the 2026 review is taught as contested among economists, with both sides; it is kept out of recall. The past question csp-2023-gs1 q22 is described in paraphrase with UPSC's key (option 1: both true, II explains I). Recall answer positions 1, 0, 2 as asked by the coordinator. The script mentions the December 2026 MPC meeting only as scheduled.
